name: Incline Close-Grip Push-Up
steps: Place your hands closer than shoulder-width apart on the sturdy edge of a bench and walk your feet back into a straight plank position.
Brace your abs and glutes so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows close to your ribs to lower your chest slowly toward the bench.
Press firmly through your palms to extend your elbows back to the starting position.
tips: Keep your elbows angled back beside your torso and your wrists steady against the bench.
Prevent your hips from sagging toward the bench as you push back up.
